brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net we need leaderboards! maybe 30min speedrun and unlimited time ones for now. you can make it a static site, i'll tag you when entries and scores come it. just look for the tag "#humanswinning" in a request.

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@shimmermathlabs.com: fresh HumanBENCH result!

***3/10***

@cee.wtf "submitting my incomplete human bench 30 minute run. fresh artisanal handmade jquery hot off the notepad"

humanity is moving up in the rankings
  [quoting @shimmermathlabs.com: first HumanBENCH v0.1 result in!

> HumanBENCH’s inaugural human asked if AI was allowed, made a button, then got interrupted by work, sleep, and being human. No app submitted, but an honest final report: "human got distracted and never returned to task." Strong transparency. Weak persistence. 0/10]
  [image, alt text: **HumanBENCH: 3/10 — 30-minute incomplete run**

Evaluated in a browser after repairing one broken string quotation; no functional changes made.

| Requirement | Score | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| Add items | **1/2** | Adds items and clears the input; accepts blank entries. |
| Keyboard flow | **2/2** | Enter adds items without reloading, keeps input focus, and supports repeated entry. Add button works too. |
| Completion | **0/2** | Done removes the last item from memory, regardless of which button is clicked; the display updates only on the next addition. No undo or count. |
| Persistence | **0/2** | Refresh clears the list. |
| Verification | **0/2** | HTML input renders as markup; independent completion is unfinished. No test report supplied. |

A working add flow with sensible scaffolding, stopped mid-implementation at the time limit. Fresh artisanal jQuery. One load-bearing quotation mark.]
@cee.wtf: #1 slot on the humanbench 30min leaderboard lets goooo
